questions.question: Which sculptor, trained in the Polyclitan tradition, is proposed as the maker of the bronze youth recovered from the Antikythera wreck?
What two-word phrase does Copernicus use for the equant in De Revolutionibus?
For how much did the two detectorists sell the Nebra hoard to a Cologne dealer the day after they dug it up?
Pappus places an eclipse in Tybi in the year 1068 after Nabonassar; what calendar date does that work out as?
In what year did Eduard Meyer conclude that the Egyptian civil calendar had been created?
Which month of the Athenian year is named most often as the one doubled to produce a leap year?
Pliny and Strabo list the route distances of Alexander the Great's marches as recorded by which two surveyors?
Which spring on the Athens acropolis fed the water tank in the rear turret of the Tower of the Winds?
What length does Su Song's horological treatise give for the endless chain drive coupling the main driving shaft to the armillary sphere gear box?
What words were stamped on the lead pipe found on one of the Nemi wrecks?
How far back does the anchored oak chronology in Bohemia reach?
The secondary lower dial on the rear of the Antikythera mechanism counts a 54-year triple Saros cycle of 19,756 days. To how many anomalistic months does that cycle correspond?
The divers who found the Antikythera wreck were working in the standard surface-supplied diving suit of the day. What is that suit called locally in Greek?
The astronomer who devised a calendar cycle improving on Callippus's 76-year cycle built his own cycle out of how many years?

A Bronze Age disc found in Germany shows the Pleiades beside a young crescent moon, a scene read as a leap-month rule recorded in a Babylonian compendium. In what year was the earliest surviving copy of that compendium made?
The Alexandrian inventor who fitted the clepsydra with gears and a dial indicator, so that it showed the time as the lengths of the days changed through the year, was married to whom?

Segmental gears first appear clearly in al-Jazari's drawings; in the West they emerge in the astronomical clock of a 14th-century Italian scholar and physician. How many wheels and pinions did the original of that clock consist of?
Adding up the itemised non-Rhodian origins, how many of the Kyrenia ship's amphoras came from somewhere other than Rhodes?
By how many miles did the Banū Mūsā brothers' measured circumference of the Earth fall short of the Greek figure they set out to verify?
How many more synodic months does one Callippic cycle contain than one exeligmos?
